about_short_description.short_description: Moots handcraft high-performance titanium bicycle frames and components in a small factory in Steamboat Springs, CO.

product.name: Handcrafted Titanium Gravel Bikes
product.description: Titanium gravel bikes for racing, endurance riding, bikepacking, touring, and mixed-surface use, offered as framesets or complete builds.

product.name: Handcrafted Titanium Road Bikes
product.description: Titanium road and all-road bicycles designed for responsive performance, comfort, durability, and riding across pavement, chip seal, and light gravel.

product.name: Handcrafted Titanium Mountain Bikes
product.description: Titanium mountain bikes and frames for cross-country, trail, hardtail, bikepacking, and technical backcountry riding.

identifier.value: Custom Bike Builds and Fit Options

product.name: Custom Bike Builds and Fit Options
product.description: Customer-configured Moots bicycles with options for framesets or complete builds, finishes, accent colors, component specifications, cable routing, and selected geometry changes.

product.name: Titanium Components and Replacement Parts
product.description: Bicycle components and service parts including titanium cranks, stems, seatposts, forks, cockpit components, replacement hardware, and computer mounts.

product.name: Frame Refurbishment Service
product.description: A service for refurbishing existing Moots frames to restore their condition and extend their usable life.
